scope: Shared semantic and optical acceptance inventory for Petrucci proof rendering and LilyPond publication export.

petrucci_contract: rhythm marks register with chord onsets

upstream.borrowed_invariant: partial measures do not shift or invent beam groups
beamlet direction and breaks remain deterministic

petrucci_contract: voice and lute remain vertically registered
lilypond_contract: voice and tablature share bar geometry

upstream.borrowed_invariant: syllables follow voice events without changing rhythmic alignment

petrucci_contract: dots and accidentals retain deterministic lanes

upstream.borrowed_invariant: seconds, unisons, dots, and accidentals do not overlap

petrucci_contract: continuation cues survive viewport and system boundaries
lilypond_contract: ties and slurs survive explicit line breaks

upstream.borrowed_invariant: broken ties retain both visible endpoints

petrucci_contract: volta labels do not collide with music
lilypond_contract: repeat barlines and volta hooks compile without warnings

upstream.borrowed_invariant: volta hooks terminate on eligible barlines

petrucci_contract: all syllables survive structured FT3 rows
the final-only coda remains attached to the final stanza
lilypond_contract: vocal, lyrics, and tablature share four-bar systems
two systems fit each page without clipping or lyric collisions
editorial intro and coda cues retain their source bars

upstream.borrowed_invariant: dense strophic lyrics remain onset-aligned across four registered mixed-score systems
